name: KanDDDinsky 2027
description: Community Domain-Driven Design conference with workshops and open space
note: Conference + workshops + open space, English; next edition announced without dates
dateNote: dates not announced; last edition 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-16
details: Community-organized DDD conference in Berlin, the 2026 edition being its ninth year. In 2026: workshops 12-13 October, talks and hands-on sessions 14-15 October, open space 16 October at Park Inn by Radisson Berlin Alexanderplatz; all sessions in English, with a focus on AI-assisted development in a DDD context. The official site only says a next edition is coming; dates, venue and prices for 2027 unconfirmed.
